title: One Month Old
desc: One whole month of you. Four weeks of learning, laughing, crying, and falling more in love every single day.
story: You weigh 4.1 kg now and you've grown 3cm. Your hair is still a little dark fuzz on the top of your head and you make the most extraordinary sounds — little squeaks and sighs that we could listen to forever. You prefer sleeping on Dad's chest and you hate having your nappy changed with a passion.
